subject: Dragon
object: Lock-on dodging, then casting the strongest skill
text: While the dragon uses a skill, unlock the camera and move to a spot it cannot hit, then cast the strongest skill without locking on.

evidence.quote: Strat that i used: When he goes use any of his skills, just unlock of him and go to a place that he dosen't hit you. After this, while he is still using his skill, use your most powerfull skill, without locking the cam on him.

subject: Dragon
object: Targeting the partner to draw attention
text: Unlocking and targeting the partner gives time to cast the strongest skill on the dragon.

evidence.quote: You can unlock can to make your parthner the target, giving you some time to cast your most powerfull skill on him.

subject: Dragon
object: Dragon gets stuck in its room
text: Attacking the dragon and leaving its room leaves it stuck in the room, since it is too big to pass through the exit.

evidence.quote: One thing that i've discovered by playing the story a second time: if you atack the dragon, them go out of him room, he will be stuck on the room, since he is too big to pass trought it.

subject: Dragon
object: Exploiting the stuck dragon by spamming attacks
text: Exploiting the stuck dragon lets the player keep spamming attacks while it barely reacts.

evidence.quote: You can abuse that as well to just keep spamming, and he will barely react

subject: Hell Walls
object: Staying far away and spamming the best skill
text: Staying far from Hell Walls with aim lock and spamming the best skill, hoping Asuna survives the tanking, was one player's strategy.

evidence.quote: My strategy for this was just stay far away from him, with the aim unlock, and spammjing the best skill that i had, hoping that asuna won't die in the process of tanking him
